**1 — Scene:** A mixed roast-meat plate with an apple and a fresh rice-paper roll. The central bone-in meat is difficult to identify; it resembles a small lamb shank. The upper-right meat appears to be roast pork with crackling.

**2 — Vessel:** A dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across. Area: 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Whole apple; fresh vegetable/shrimp rice-paper roll; central roast meat; skin-on chicken breast; a separate chicken breast strip; roast pork with crackling. No distinct sauce or added oil is visible.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **519 g of edible food and 974 kcal** is plausible for the visible apple, small roll and several portions of roast meat. Meat identification and the amount of fatty skin are the main uncertainties.
